斯拉萊管是柬埔寨氣鳴樂器，以四片簧片發聲，簧片組以棕櫚葉製成。管身內孔並非均勻鑽: The sralai is a Cambodian aerophone that sounds with four reeds, the reed assembly being made of palm leaf. The bore is not drilled evenly but is slightly conical; it is a relative of the Western oboe, which uses a double reed and a conical tube. The player must master circular breathing so that the sound goes on without a break. The sralai is used in the pinpeat orchestra, where it is the only wind instrument and the other instruments tune to its pitch; its construction and playing technique are very close to the Thai pi.
斯拉萊管源自東南亞，在柬埔寨音樂傳統中佔有重要地位。作為平碧樂隊的唯一風樂器，它: The sralai comes from Southeast Asia and holds an important place in the Cambodian musical tradition. As the only wind instrument of the pinpeat ensemble it carries the musical heritage of Khmer civilisation. The instrument uses a four-part reed made of palm leaf, which works in much the same way as the Western oboe and reflects a different path in the musical development of each culture. The conical bore of the sralai has been finished with care by generations of craftsmen and stands for the fine craft of Cambodian traditional instrument making. As cultural exchange within Southeast Asia deepened, the sralai's influence gradually reached beyond Cambodia and won recognition in the region's musical culture. Its particular timbre and technique, especially the use of circular breathing, make it an important subject for the study of traditional performance, and it still has an irreplaceable part in court music and folk ensembles.
斯拉萊管的管身主要採用竹製或木製材料製成，確保良好的共鳴特性。四重簧片由棕櫚葉製: The body of the sralai is made mainly of bamboo or wood, for good resonance. The four-part reed is made of palm leaf, specially treated so that it has the right spring and tonal character. The conical bore is carefully finished by the craftsmen, and the internal structure has been improved over generations. The fingerholes are drilled unevenly, cut precisely with traditional tools, which shows the fine craft of Khmer traditional instrument making.
斯拉萊管音色高亢尖銳，具有穿透力強的特點，帶有明亮而略帶鼻音的質感。其音域主要集: The sralai has a high, shrill timbre that carries strongly, bright with a somewhat nasal quality. Its range is mostly the middle and upper register, the tone rounded but with a particular nasal resonance that gives a warm yet sharp impression. The vibration of the four reeds produces a complex overtone structure, so the timbre has both the warmth of a national flavour and the carrying power of a modern wind instrument. Beside the mellowness of the Western oboe the sralai is rougher and more forceful; beside the clarity of the flute its timbre has more weight and more wear. This particular sound makes it the leading instrument of the pinpeat ensemble, clear and far-carrying outdoors, and it expresses the spirit of Cambodian traditional music to the full.
